title: M3.3: Slack installation (OAuth v2) and bindings
description:
OAuth install flow initiated by an owner in the web app, state protected, callback on the front door, workspace bot token written to the path-scoped SSM SecureString, binding created per workspace with a default bot per Slack channel set by an owner. Uninstall and token revocation events disable the binding.

Acceptance criteria:
- Install from a development workspace creates a binding owned by the initiating organization
- State mismatch or replay is rejected
- Revocation event disables the binding and stops delivery
- Token never appears in logs, responses or DynamoDB

Gherkin: features/slack_installation.feature

Depends on: M3.2

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
